custom_css: @keyframes vtDoorGlow { from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(201,167,88,.0); } to { box-shadow: 0 0 22px 4px rgba(201,167,88,.55); } } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__panel { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, #fffaf0 0%, #f8f3e7 48%, #efe4c8 100%); } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid #c9a758; border-radius: clamp(90px, 40%, 160px) clamp(90px, 40%, 160px) 10px 10px / 56px 56px 10px 10px; pointer-events: none; } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__eyebrow { color: #a44932; letter-spacing: 2px; } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__title { letter-spacing: .3px; } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__media { border: 1px solid #c9a758; border-radius: 999px 999px 8px 8px; overflow: hidden; animation: vtDoorGlow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } & .vt-bloomreach-landing__cta { box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(255,162,32,.35); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { & .vt-bloomreach-landing__media { animation: none; } }
